# SPEC.md — AI Mystery Room Specification

## 1. Project Overview & Architecture
**AI Mystery Room** is a full-stack, AI-powered detective web application where players create and solve dynamic mysteries generated by Google Gemini. The application delivers an immersive, noir/thematic sleuthing experience where players investigate suspects, discover clues, uncover contradictions, conduct real-time AI suspect interrogations, assemble a visual corkboard evidence map, and submit structured accusations.

### 1.1 Architecture Diagram
```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                              CLIENT (React + Vite)                      |
|  - Pages: Home, Create, Investigation Room (Dossier, Clues, Corkboard,  |
|           Notebook, Timeline), Accusation, Results, Case File, Leaderboard |
|  - State: React Router, Axios, Custom Theme Engine, Web Audio Ambience  |
+------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                     | JSON REST API (CORS + Rate Limited)
                                     v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                           SERVER (Node.js + Express)                    |
|  - Security: Helmet, Express-Rate-Limit, CORS, Zod Request Validation  |
|  - Core Engines: Case Gen, Dual-Pass Solvability, Scoring, Anti-Leak DTO |
|  - Interrogation Agent: Gemini Persona Roleplay with Hidden Constraints |
+------------------+----------------------------------+-------------------+
                   |                                  |
                   v                                  v
+-----------------------------------+  +----------------------------------+
|       MongoDB / Mongoose          |  |         Google Gemini API        |
|  - Secret fields (select: false)  |  |  - Case Generation (JSON Schema) |
|  - Indexed queries                |  |  - Solvability & Consistency     |
|  - Game state persistence         |  |  - Suspect Interrogation Agent   |
+-----------------------------------+  +----------------------------------+
```

## 2. Tech Stack & Environment Variables

### 2.1 Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React (icons), React Router DOM v6, Axios, Canvas/SVG for string connections.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB with Mongoose, `@google/genai` (official Google Gen AI SDK), Zod, Cors, Dotenv, Helmet, Express-Rate-Limit.
- **Language / Environment**: JavaScript / ESM (`"type": "module"` in both client and server).

### 2.2 Environment Configurations
#### Backend (`server/.env`):
```env
PORT=5000
MONGODB_URI=mongodb+srv://<user>:<password>@cluster.mongodb.net/ai_mystery_room?retryWrites=true&w=majority
GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSy...
GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash
CLIENT_URL=http://localhost:5173
NODE_ENV=development
```
#### Frontend (`client/.env`):
```env
VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api
```

## 3. Data Model & Database Design

### 3.1 Mongoose Case Schema (`server/src/models/Case.js`)
```typescript
interface Suspect {
  id: string;               // e.g., "suspect_1"
  name: string;
  role: string;             // Occupation / relation to crime
  avatar: string;           // Avatar portrait key / URL
  publicBio: string;        // Known public information
  privateProfile: {         // Hidden from client: select: false
    alibi: string;
    actualActions: string;
    secrets: string;
    motiveSummary: string;
    temperament: string;    // e.g., "defensive", "calm", "nervous"
  };
}

interface Clue {
  id: string;               // e.g., "clue_1"
  title: string;
  text: string;
  location: string;         // Room / scene location found
  category: "physical" | "document" | "testimony" | "timeline";
  isRedHerring: boolean;    // Hidden from client: select: false
  pointsTo: string;         // suspectId - Hidden: select: false
  discovered: boolean;
  discoveredAt?: Date;
}

interface Hint {
  level: 1 | 2 | 3;         // 1: gentle nudge, 2: stronger lead, 3: pointed
  text: string;
  used: boolean;
  usedAt?: Date;
}

interface Solution {         // Entire block hidden: select: false
  culpritId: string;
  motive: string;
  method: string;
  explanation: string;
  decisiveClueIds: string[];
  contradiction: {
    suspectId: string;
    statementKey: string;
    clueId: string;
    explanation: string;
  };
}

interface CorkboardNode {
  id: string;
  type: "suspect" | "clue" | "note";
  refId?: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  text?: string;
}

interface CorkboardConnection {
  fromNodeId: string;
  toNodeId: string;
  label?: string;
}

interface InterrogationMessage {
  suspectId: string;
  sender: "player" | "suspect";
  message: string;
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface ScoreBreakdown {
  baseAccusation: number;       // +100 / +150 / +200 if correct
  motiveBonus: number;           // +25 if correct motive selected
  methodBonus: number;           // +25 if correct method selected
  supportingCluesBonus: number;  // +10 per valid decisive clue, -10 per red herring
  cluesDiscoveredPoints: number; // +5 per discovered clue
  hintsPenalty: number;          // -10 per hint used
  questionsPenalty: number;      // -2 per question asked
  contradictionPoints: number;   // +10 per valid, -5 per false
  timeBonus: number;             // Optional speed bonus
  total: number;                 // Min 0
  tier: "Master Detective" | "Sharp Eye" | "Close Call" | "Case Cold";
}
```

### 3.2 Security & Anti-Leak DTO Serialization
- Secret fields (`privateProfile`, `isRedHerring`, `pointsTo`, `solution`) MUST have `{ select: false }` at the Mongoose schema level.
- Even if Mongoose populates or a query lacks `.select()`, an explicit DTO sanitizer (`sanitizeCaseForPlayer(caseDoc)`) runs on every active gameplay endpoint.
- Only `/api/cases/:id/result` and `/api/cases/:id/file` (after status === 'completed') serialize the `solution` and `isRedHerring` fields.

## 4. Game Rules, Difficulty & Scoring Engine

### 4.1 Difficulty Matrix
| Difficulty | Suspects | Clues (Total) | Red Herrings | Hints | Question Allowance | Base Score |
|------------|----------|---------------|--------------|-------|--------------------|------------|
| **Easy**   | 3        | 5             | 1            | 2     | 6 questions        | 100 pts    |
| **Medium** | 4        | 7             | 2            | 3     | 8 questions        | 150 pts    |
| **Hard**   | 5        | 9             | 3            | 3     | 10 questions       | 200 pts    |

### 4.2 Scoring Formula
$$\text{Total Score} = \max\Big(0, S_{\text{base}} + S_{\text{motive}} + S_{\text{method}} + S_{\text{clues\_valid}} - S_{\text{clues\_red}} + S_{\text{discovered}} - S_{\text{hints}} - S_{\text{questions}} + S_{\text{contradictions}} + S_{\text{timer}}\Big)$$

- **Base Accusation**: Correct: Easy (+100), Medium (+150), Hard (+200). Incorrect: 0.
- **Structured Deductions**: Correct Motive (+25), Correct Method (+25).
- **Supporting Clues**: +10 for each chosen clue matching `solution.decisiveClueIds`; -10 for choosing red herrings.
- **Investigation Actions**: Discovered clues (+5 each), Hints used (-10 each), Interrogation questions (-2 each, capped by allowance), Valid contradiction flag (+10), False contradiction flag (-5).
- **Speed Bonus (Optional Timed Mode)**: +1 per 10 seconds remaining on the timer.
- **Verdict Tiers**:
  - `Master Detective`: Correct culprit + correct motive + correct method + score $\ge$ 150.
  - `Sharp Eye`: Correct culprit + either motive or method correct.
  - `Close Call`: Correct culprit, but flawed deductions or heavy hint/question penalties.
  - `Case Cold`: Wrong culprit chosen.

## 5. Gemini AI Generation Pipeline & Prompt Architecture

### 5.1 Pipeline Flow
```
User Premise + Theme + Difficulty
           │
           ▼
[Sanitization & Injection Guardrail]
  - Truncate premise to 300 chars
  - Strip markdown, system control overrides, jailbreak phrases
           │
           ▼
[Pass 1: Structured Case Generation]
  - Model: env.GEMINI_MODEL with responseMimeType: "application/json"
  - Strict JSON Schema enforcing exact suspect, clue, hint, and red herring counts
           │
           ▼
[Zod Schema Validation]
  - Validate exact array lengths per difficulty
  - Verify culpritId exists in suspects list
  - Verify decisiveClueIds exist in clues list
           │
           ▼
[Pass 2: Solvability & Consistency Check]
  - Second Gemini call evaluates: "Does this clue set logically point to one and only one culprit without logical contradictions?"
  - If fails: Auto-retry with corrective feedback (up to 2 retries)
  - If valid: Save to MongoDB with solution hidden
```

### 5.2 Suspect Interrogation Agent Prompting
When a player interrogates a suspect:
- Gemini is given a specialized prompt containing:
  - Crime context & public details
  - **Only** this specific suspect's `privateProfile` (their alibi, what they actually did, their secrets, and their psychological profile).
  - Rules: Culprit deflects or constructs deceptive half-truths but never openly confesses; innocent suspects defend their actual alibis; suspects never mention non-diegetic game terms (e.g. "clues", "points", "Gemini", "red herring").
  - The conversation history for this suspect in this case.

## 6. API Specifications

| Method | Endpoint | Description | Auth / Access |
|--------|----------|-------------|---------------|
| `POST` | `/api/cases` | Generate new mystery (sanitized input, dual-pass AI) | Rate limit: 5/hr |
| `GET`  | `/api/cases/daily` | Fetch today's seeded daily mystery | Public |
| `GET`  | `/api/cases/:id` | Fetch active case (solution & secrets stripped) | Public |
| `POST` | `/api/cases/:id/clues/:clueId/discover` | Unlock/discover a clue (+5 pts) | Active case only |
| `POST` | `/api/cases/:id/hints` | Unlock next progressive hint (-10 pts) | Active case only |
| `POST` | `/api/cases/:id/interrogate` | Send interrogation question to a suspect (-2 pts) | Active case only |
| `POST` | `/api/cases/:id/contradictions` | Submit statement + clue pair (+10 or -5 pts) | Active case only |
| `PUT`  | `/api/cases/:id/board` | Save corkboard nodes, positions, notes, and strings | Active case only |
| `PUT`  | `/api/cases/:id/notebook` | Save player's custom detective notes | Active case only |
| `POST` | `/api/cases/:id/accuse` | Submit culprit + motive + method + supporting clues | Active case only |
| `GET`  | `/api/cases/:id/result` | Get full solution, score breakdown, AI critique | **Completed only (403 if active)** |
| `GET`  | `/api/cases/:id/file` | Read-only shareable case file | Completed only |
| `GET`  | `/api/leaderboard` | Top 10 rankings per difficulty | Public |
| `GET`  | `/api/cases/history/:playerId` | Player's past cases & performance | Public |

## 7. Frontend Pages & Component Specifications

### 7.1 Pages
1. **Home (`/`)**:
   - Atmospheric noir header, animated typewriter intro, theme toggle (Noir, Victorian Manor, Sci-Fi Station, Cozy Village, Cyberpunk).
   - "Start New Mystery", "Play Daily Case", "Leaderboard", and "Case History".
   - Ambient sound toggle (off by default; subtle rain/noir ambient synth via Web Audio API).
2. **Create Mystery (`/create`)**:
   - Premise prompt input with quick starter chips ("Locked Room in an Art Gallery", "Murder on an Antarctic Station", "Poison at a High Society Gala").
   - Theme selector & Difficulty selector (Easy, Medium, Hard).
   - Timed mode toggle (optional countdown timer with score multiplier).
   - Immersive loader with animated typewriter status logs during Gemini generation.
3. **Investigation Room (`/case/:id`)**:
   - **Header bar**: Case Title, Difficulty, Score Tracker, Questions Left, Timer (if enabled), "Make Accusation" CTA button.
   - **Tab Navigation**:
     - **Tab 1: Suspect Dossiers**: Suspect cards with public bios, interactive "Interrogate" button opening a 1-on-1 dialogue modal with live response typing.
     - **Tab 2: Clue Locker & Forensic Lab**: Scene locations, undiscovered clue cards ready to inspect/discover, interactive inspection viewer.
     - **Tab 3: Evidence Corkboard**: Draggable cards, red string connections between suspects and clues, pin notes, auto-saved to backend.
     - **Tab 4: Notebook & Timeline**: Auto-updating chronological timeline derived from discovered clues + freeform detective notepad.
   - **Drawer / Modal**: Progressive Hint requester (shows penalty warning before revealing).
4. **Accusation Modal / Page (`/case/:id/accuse`)**:
   - Suspect Line-up: Pick the prime suspect.
   - Select Motive dropdown & Method dropdown.
   - Select 1 to 3 Supporting Clues from discovered evidence.
   - Written deduction statement ("Explain your reasoning").
   - Confirmation dialog before final lock-in.
5. **Results Page (`/case/:id/result`)**:
   - Dramatic verdict banner ("CASE CLOSED: GUILTY VERDICT" or "CASE COLD: WRONGFUL ACCUSATION").
   - Score breakdown card with Detective Rank Badge (Master Detective, Sharp Eye, Close Call, Case Cold).
   - Gemini "Detective Review" evaluating the player's deduction vs actual evidence.
   - Full Unlocked Dossier: Culprit identity, true motive, method, decisive clues vs red herrings.
   - Actions: "Share Case File", "View Leaderboard", "Start New Case".
6. **Shareable Case File (`/case/:id/file`)**:
   - Clean, printable/shareable dossier view with a generated score badge and summary suitable for showing friends.
7. **Leaderboard & History (`/leaderboard`)**:
   - Filterable by difficulty; shows Player Nickname, Theme, Score, Detective Tier, and Date.

## 8. Acceptance Criteria & Test Plan

### 8.1 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Mysteries generate cleanly at Easy (3 suspects, 5 clues, 2 hints), Medium (4 suspects, 7 clues, 3 hints), and Hard (5 suspects, 9 clues, 3 hints).
- [ ] No leakage: Automated unit test verifies `isCulprit`, `privateProfile`, `isRedHerring`, `pointsTo`, and `solution` are completely absent from `GET /api/cases/:id` responses prior to accusation.
- [ ] Interrogation endpoint enforces question allowance and charges -2 points per question.
- [ ] Contradiction detection awards +10 for matching suspect-clue pairs and penalizes -5 for invalid attempts.
- [ ] Backend calculates all scoring authoritatively and rejects client-tampered scores.
- [ ] Result endpoint rejects with 403 Forbidden until a valid accusation is submitted.
- [ ] The app handles Gemini timeouts or malformed outputs with retries and friendly user fallbacks.
- [ ] Responsive design works across mobile (375px+), tablet, and desktop viewports.

---

## 9. Deployment Plan
- **Frontend**: Deployed to Vercel with `vercel.json` rewrites for SPA routing (`/* -> index.html`) and `VITE_API_URL` pointing to backend.
- **Backend**: Deployed to Render or Railway with environment variables (`PORT`, `MONGODB_URI`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_MODEL`, `CLIENT_URL`).
- **Database**: MongoDB Atlas M0 cluster with IP whitelist `0.0.0.0/0`.
